title: Shop Vac (kinetic typography animation)
summary: A kinetic typography animation for Jonathan Coulton's song 'Shop Vac', made by Jarrett Heather with Illustrator, After Effects and other tools over 500-1000 hours.
why: Praised as a standout example of kinetic typography that holds attention, and known as the earlier work that led to the animator's Weird Al 'Word Crimes' video.

quote.text: this amazing piece of kinetic typography / video done to Jonathan Coulton's Shop-Vac
